hooks.name: Sync extension types when schemas change
hooks.description: When backend/app/schemas.py changes, asks the agent to regenerate the extension's API types and fix any callers. Uses credits (agent action).

action.prompt: backend/app/schemas.py just changed. If the backend is running on localhost:8000, regenerate the extension types with `cd extension && pnpm openapi-typescript http://localhost:8000/openapi.json -o lib/api-types.ts`; if it isn't running, tell me to start it with `cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app` and stop. Then update any extension code that uses changed types, and run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`. Do not hand-edit lib/api-types.ts.
